description: Controlled vocabulary for the `designations` row column. A row may carry several codes, space-separated, e.g. "CC CL". Validation rejects any code not listed here. New codes are added by PR to this file with evidence of the printed form.

RCUP.name: All-Star Rookie Cup
RCUP.note: Topps All-Star Rookie trophy. Not always noted on manufacturer checklists even when printed on the card.

LL.name: League Leaders
LL.note: Usually a multi-subject card; see the multi-subject rule in ROW-FORMAT.md.

TC.name: Team Card
TC.note: `name` holds the team name; `team` repeats it.

CC.name: Combo Card
CC.note: Multiple players in one photo. Independent of CL: 2026 Topps prints "Combo Card" alone (CC), 2025 Topps prints "Combo Card/Checklist" (CC CL).

CL.name: Checklist
CL.note: The card's back is a checklist.

WSH.name: World Series Highlights
WSH.note: A base card commemorating a World Series moment, the same shape as LL. Topps prints World Series in 2018 (four Astros cards for the 2017 Series) and World Series Highlights from 2019 on; one code, both printed forms.

GM.name: Greatest Moments
GM.note: A category Topps prints per card inside 2019 Series 1's 150-card 150 Years of Professional Baseball insert. These are the manufacturer's own taxonomy, not this repo's: 2019 Series 2 promotes the same five names to separate inserts with their own numbering (GP-1 to GP-50, GM-1 to GM-25, GS-1 to GS-25, and the two Evolution sets), where they are checklists rather than designations.

HRL.name: HR Leaders
HRL.note: The statistic a League Leaders card ranks, printed alongside LL by 2022 Topps: "48 Guerrero Jr./Perez/Ohtani AL HR Leaders League Leaders" is "LL HRL". Carried with LL, never instead of it. Earlier and later years print League Leaders alone, so these appear only where Topps printed them.
